name: sillonette
description: Sillonette: shows the YouTube Music track in OBS, without any server (OBS WebSocket on the same PC)

scripts.lint: npm run typecheck && npm run build && node scripts/check-manifest.mjs
scripts.lint:firefox: npm --prefix tools/web-ext ci && tools/web-ext/node_modules/.bin/web-ext lint --self-hosted=false -s dist/firefox
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run lint:firefox && npm run e2e
